verdict.rationale: Relay documents bookkeeping automations that would speed month-end close: real-time receipt capture and expense categorization with automatic sync to accounting software (relay-docs-3), plus detailed transaction syncing into QuickBooks Online and Xero (relay-docs-19). None of this is described as AI-driven, and nothing ties it to the close process itself. missing for 10: any evidence the automations use AI, month-end close or reconciliation workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync and categorization actually shorten the close.
